name: scryer-mcp
description: Spec-driven development where the spec is your tests: the architecture derived from the code, claims from behaviour tests.
long_description: Agents orient on a task, write each behaviour as a todo test before building, run only the tests their change reaches, and probe what they doubt. Every tool takes an absolute `project` path. For hooks and the skill in Claude Code, Codex or Copilot CLI, run `scryer-mcp setup on` in the project.
